cohort: 40 patients (13 pregnant women and 27 newborns) with confirmed listeriosis admitted to the Northwest Women's and Children's Hospital (NWCH) in Xi'an, China, from 2011 to 2020
finding: Listeriosis was a rare disease in Xi'an, China, with seasonal variation, and was associated with distinct maternal and neonatal symptoms and laboratory findings, including fever, abdominal pain, respiratory distress, elevated CRP, WBC, neutrophils, and monocytes.
